newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB, Daily Mail in TV talks - paper.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB, Daily Mail in TV talks - paper.

text.p: Daily Mail & General Trust Plc is in talks with satellite broadcaster BSkyB to develop a television channel focusing on lifestyle themes, the Independent newspaper said.

No-one was immediately available to comment at either media group Daily Mail & General or BSkyB. The newspaper said the proposed channel would be called Daily Mail TV and would be introduced as part of BSkyB's mulit-channel package on digital satellite to be launched at the end of next year.
BSkyB's largest shareholder is Rupert Murdoch's News Corp.
It plans to offer some 200 channels when it launches digital satellite television in Britain next year.
BSkyB has emerged as the dominant force in British pay television in the 1990s. Daily Mail & General publishes the Daily Mail and Mail on Sunday newspapers.
It holds a 20 percent stake in the ITN television news supplier and owns Channel One, a cable television channel.
